retainedSource.sourceLevel: Archived digital transcription, not a facsimile collation of all rules

rules.minor: Male forward/female reverse regardless of birth-stem polarity; 寅午戌 start 辰, 申子辰 start 戌, 巳酉丑 start 未, 亥卯未 start 丑. Compared with real iztro for 12 birth branches/both genders.
rules.month: Start from annual earthly branch, count backwards to effective birth month, forwards to birth hour, then forwards target effective month. All choices same/next/split16 are explicit and used on birth and target months.
rules.year: Lunar year and nominal age follow the chart timezone; new year switches at lunar New Year, not Gregorian Jan 1 or Li Chun.
rules.annualTransformations: Use existing selected Toan Thu stem table; Nham Khoa = Thien Phu. Actual iztro 2.6.2 uses Ta Phu for this cell; preserve and report the difference. Applying the birth-stem table to the annual stem is a declared implementation convention, not a newly verified ancient passage.
rules.decade: Use the existing natal engine daHanStart/cuc ranges, first decade at Menh; before its start show none. Do not use native iztro childhood substitution as a decade. The short digital An Dai Han passage begins adjacent-palace counting and does not by itself resolve the whole starting-age convention; real runtime comparison checks the currently selected convention only.

publicReading: Three actual natal-palace topics selected by decade/year/month indices. This is not a full combined-star annual forecast, migrating natal stars or an event prediction.
scope: No daily/hourly periods or automated good/bad-year score. Calendar-sensitive target intervals are rejected for review.
